summary: 26/26 keys. Archon re-cut + Wowhead M+ healer rebuild: 6 tier, 3 consensus, 1 projection move. No new PTR builds. WCL rdps still broken, 3 raw keys landed. Murlok held (S2 reset).

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 182-329 KB. Parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = the tier letter; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally): raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves against stored. 79 RATED rows, because Subtlety Rogue's M+ DPS cell again reads the literal upstream TBD and is stored as an explicit null rather than omitted or guessed. Era read from each page's own title AND changelog body: five titles self-identify as 12.1 / Season 2, and the raid-HEALER page again keeps a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a changelog reading "13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch after the first few live tests" — body over title per the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six, NO seasonVerified value changed this run, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to freeze. published re-read per page, never carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-13 (JSON-LD dateModified; the in-body "Last UPDATED" says 08-10 and dateModified wins), raid tank 08-08, M+ x3 08-08 — agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots advanced 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-17.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 189-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way this era-gated source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)" and the newest changelog row is "09 Aug. 2026: Final Update of the progressive S2 PTR Midnight tierlist". 39 rated assignments (26 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) from 40 parsed rows, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves — no rebuild since the 08-09 cut, and that changelog line now says the progressive PTR series is FINISHED, so a quiet week here is expected rather than a lag. Subtlety Rogue is again the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null; 39 rated rows against a floor of 24. published RE-READ from each page: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with the deterministic published-evidence artifact (the in-body "Last UPDATED" still says 08-02; dateModified wins per refresh-tiers precedence). Snapshots advanced to 2026-08-17. Era-gated out of the live consensus and read only by the projection, so its quiet week moved no published letter.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Non-roster alts rejected by ROSTER MATCH and never by position — the 8 Season-2 dungeon names (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) on the M+ page plus the Method logo. Era re-verified from the bodies: the raid page names "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", the M+ page "Mythic+ content and dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2" and credits Tactyks, with ZERO Season 1 mentions on either. seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right, into the next-patch forecast, its final s1 letters held in data/season-final.json so the consensus composition is unchanged. Snapshots advanced to 2026-08-17.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 08-03), HTTP 200, 73-328 KB. Unescaped \/ -> / across the whole document BEFORE searching for [tier-list=rows], then split on [tier-label ...] with tolerant whitespace: exactly ONE tier-list block per page (the raid-healer decoy printHtml was not in play), 27/7/6 + 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched via the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. TWO TIER MOVES, both on the M+ HEALER page, both explained by a rebuild: Restoration Druid B -> C and Discipline Priest B -> C, and that page's JSON-LD dateModified moved 2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-16T17:07:04-05:00, agreeing with published-evidence/evidence.json (which the publish gate cross-checks). Its stored published was advanced 08-09 -> 08-16 accordingly; the other five published values re-read unchanged (raid DPS 08-14, raid healer 08-16, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS 08-15, M+ tank 08-11), 6/6 agreement with the artifact. Era-verified per page: all six titles read "for Midnight Season 2" (s2, season-AHEAD, frozen-lane letters keep the consensus composition). Snapshots advanced to 2026-08-17.

All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 63-98 KB, parsed from the <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> JSON (WebFetch markdown drops it) at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists — raid from the metric:"throughput" list, M+ from metric:"score", never the default popularity grouping; every entry resolved from its icon "Class-Spec" token, never the display name ("BeastMastery Hunter" / "Blood DeathKnight" match no roster entry), and tiers[].entries is a list OF LISTS. 27/7/6 + 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched. FOUR TIER MOVES, all raid: Shadow Priest S -> A, Frost Mage S -> A, Protection Warrior A -> S, Blood Death Knight A -> S. Corroboration is arithmetic, from the same payload's own throughput values: Shadow 187.4k and Frost Mage 186.7k now sit below Elemental Shaman's 189.6k (the S cut), while Protection Warrior 104.7k and Blood DK 100.3k joined Guardian Druid 108.7k in tank S. lastUpdated moved 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z -> 2026-08-16T12:00:00Z on all six pages. Era: still the nine Season-1 bosses and eight Season-1 dungeons in encounterOptions, so seasonVerified stays s1 — Archon remains the ONLY source feeding the live consensus in its own right, which is why these four moves become the night's 3 consensus letters (Blood DK raid B -> A, Frost Mage raid S -> A+, Protection Warrior raid A+ -> S).

Full 51-page re-fetch (9 raid bosses + 8 M+ dungeons x 3 roles), 51/51 HTTP 200, same __NEXT_DATA__ + icon-token parse as the aggregate pages. 619 rows parsed; 33 tier moves and 1 newly-populated cell (Vengeance Demon Hunter on Vaelgor & Ezzorak, C — that boss had 38 stored rows and now has 39), ALL of them raid: the M+ per-dungeon cuts are byte-identical, S1 keys having been dead content since 12.1 shipped on 08-11. Six role cuts are empty upstream and were left strictly alone rather than being written as zeroes (Crown dps+healer+tank, Chimaerus healer+tank, Vanguard tank), so their 59 stored rows survive and the file holds 678 rows at Archon's own 2026-08-16. Committed encounter `name` values were preserved verbatim — page.title is the generic page headline ("Midnight DPS Rankings and VS / DR / MQD Tier List"), and taking it would rename every encounter to the same string. Single-source by design and labeled as Archon in the UI; nothing cross-checks it, which is why the row counts are printed.

Read from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages (the same __NEXT_DATA__ payload that carries throughput and popularity — Archon raid pages carry all three lists and the default view groups by popularity). 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, 2 tier moves. Merged via apply-metrics.mjs's survivability key at Archon's OWN lastUpdated date 2026-08-16, never the run date; stored asOf advanced 2026-08-14 -> 2026-08-16. Surfaced in the drawer's Source ratings box only — it is not a throughput tier and never feeds the consensus.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)", 33 rows (27 DPS + 6 tank), read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] — NOT the tierList structure, which holds only letters. Archon genuinely re-cut its RAID data: 32 of 33 rows moved in value and/or parse count, largest single move +8.6% (well inside maxValueMovePct 0.6). Floats rounded to integers to match the stored series precision, and each row's `parses` carried through as the series' n (omitting it silently deletes n from every stored row). Merged at Archon's OWN 2026-08-16 lastUpdated, never the run date. Note the label is useless as a change detector in BOTH directions — last night it ticked ahead of unmoved data, and on 08-16 it lagged behind moved data; the diff is the detector.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)", 7/7 healer rows from the raid-healer page's specRankingsSection table (hps column, floats rounded, parses carried as n). All 7 moved with the same raid re-cut; largest move 0.6%. Merged at Archon's own 2026-08-16. Kept as a separate manifest row from archon-metrics deliberately (2026-07-24 audit D4) so a failure in one series can never be hidden by the other.

Fetched successfully (3 M+ pages, HTTP 200) and re-parsed in full, but "M+ score (95th pct)" is BYTE-IDENTICAL across all 40 rows against stored — value and parse count both — so nothing was merged and the stored asOf stays at the source's own 2026-08-10. This is honest upstream staleness, not a parse failure: Season 1 keys have been dead content since 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so Archon's M+ cut has not moved in a week even though its lastUpdated label reads 2026-08-16. Stamping today's label onto frozen values would defeat the staleness gate exactly, so the row is partial and the heartbeat is left to go red — that red IS the signal. Expect this to resolve when Season 2 keys open on 08-18.

80 rows parsed (raid + M+, all roles) and shape-checked BEFORE any merge: every value a plausible percentage (0.6-39.6), the six role x bracket groups summing to 100.1/100.0/99.9/99.8/100.0/100.0 (599.8 total), and no row equal to that spec's own "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" — the check that catches the DPS-column-under-a-%-unit failure. The 40 RAID rows moved with tonight's re-cut and were merged at Archon's own 2026-08-16; the 40 M+ rows are byte-identical and frozen at 2026-08-10 with S1 keys dead. probeDate uses the min-th-freshest COVERAGE date across the whole family, so the requirement's date correctly stays 2026-08-10 and the row is partial rather than success.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers/proxy/auth (the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and must never be used). manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT — so unlike the 08-04 case, the manifest and the rankings file agree. Selected by WHITELIST (categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField==="lowerBound" + keyRange===undefined, never a "not dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 name-matched with no mapping table. All 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are IDENTICAL to stored at 1 dp, the stored series precision. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (6 days, inside the contract's threshold), never today.

It must never be substituted from the raw-DPS series that DID land tonight — different statistic, and raw DPS is never dressed up as rDPS.

Landed by the deterministic pre-agent step (src/fetch-wcl.mjs, frozen recipe #1, owner-approved 2026-07-17) — this agent neither fetched, recomputed nor edited these rows. evidence.landed reports 102 rows across the four DPS dummies with full pagination per encounter: 1T 2000 ranked players, 2T 668, 3T 297, 5T 2000. Merged as "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)" (bracket raid, era ptr, n = ranked players); 106 stored rows now dated 2026-08-17. This is metric:dps best-parse-per-player, a DIFFERENT statistic from spec.ptrDummy's median rDPS, and it never substitutes for it.

Landed by the deterministic pre-agent step; evidence.landed reports 27 rows pooled across zone 54. Six of the eight encounters returned players (Vashnik the Malignant 678, Nek'zali the Soulcoiler 370, Entombed Sentinels 363, Sszorak 184, The Lost Explorers 150, The Twin Fangs 146) and two returned zero (The Coiled Altar, Ula'tek) — an ordinary consequence of which bosses were being tested, not an error. 27 stored rows dated 2026-08-17, against a floor of 16. Independent of the zone-54 NORMALIZED series above, which rides a different transport and stays frozen.

Landed by the deterministic pre-agent step; evidence.landed reports 27 rows pooled across all eight zone-56 dungeons, each returning the full 2000-player page (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). 27 stored rows dated 2026-08-17, against a floor of 16.

All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 40-71 KB, 40/40 rows parsed by anchoring on the meta-item class — so the parse is healthy and this is a DATA decision, not a failure. MERGE HELD BACK WHOLESALE for the second night, and the case is now stronger: the roster is complete again (27 DPS, up from 22 last night) but EIGHT specs read a literal 0 (Devastation, Marksmanship, Arcane, Frost DK, Preservation, Protection Warrior, Protection Paladin, Vengeance DH) and 25 of 40 rows moved more than 10%, most of them down 19-23% (Balance 3971->3048, Holy Paladin 3935->3040, Assassination 3968->3113, Blood DK 3990->3212). The page's own <time datetime> moved to 2026-08-17T02:11Z while its title still reads "Midnight Season 1". Those eight zeros are 100% value moves against maxValueMovePct 0.6, which has NO agent-writable proposal channel, and merging the other 32 alone would publish an S1/S2 mixed pool under one series name. Stored data left byte-identical at 2026-08-15. OWNER DECISION STILL NEEDED: re-base or pause "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" across the Season-2 boundary.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 3 retries each (the 76-byte error body is transient, not structural — Beast Mastery has recovered from it before). 14 returned real data, 13 still return it after retries: Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Assassination, Outlaw, Demonology, Arms, Fury. All 14 that DID return carry simc_settings.tier "MID2" (read off the chart, never hard-coded — it moves each season) at chart timestamp 2026-08-15, while the 26 stored profiles are MID1-era. MERGED NOTHING, per the sim-tier uniformity gate: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so a 14-of-27 merge would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength — all 24 "strong" labels to the re-simmed 14 and none to the other 12. Adopt a new tier wholesale or not at all. fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHARTS' own 2026-07-08/07-15, 40 days stale, and the heartbeat goes red — which is the true signal that upstream has not finished re-simming. simc_settings.ptr compared explicitly against the STRING "0".

Both transports fetched, HTTP 200. The plain-text MID1_Raid.txt is a 220-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block — its header reads SimulationCraft 1210-01 for 12.1.0.69299 Live (hotfix 2026-08-15/69299, git build HEAD 5039a0f382), which has moved again from last night's 6641c13132, so the Season-2 re-sim is still churning. Fell back to MID1_Raid.html per the recipe: it is UNCHANGED — SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974), report timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28. Re-parsed anyway by taking the "data":[...] array enclosing the FIRST big-value MID1_ hit (a fixed byte window after "series" reads the later burst/DTPS charts at 2.2-2.5x inflation) and mapping profile names by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed: all 26 stored DPS values are byte-identical. The 6 apparent extras are tank profiles, excluded by design. Nothing merged; an unchanged build hash is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1075, HTTP 200 — the SAME period as the last three runs: "Period 1075 MID1 (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Tyrannical, Fortified, Xal'atath's Guile)". The weekly roll has not happened. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon blocks) with lowercase-hyphenated labels normalised on [-\s]+: 34 rows, 0 unmatched. Verified it is the representation SHARE and not the /meta per-key-PRESENCE column before comparing — series sum 100.3%, role subtotals DPS 60.2 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.1, max row 18.3. All 34 values identical to stored. Nothing merged; asOf stays 2026-08-14.

Four channels swept, NO new builds and nothing logged — data/ptr-builds.json is unchanged at 16 entries, newest 2026-08-15. (1) Dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest is Linxy #19 — already the feed's 07-31 entry. The thread has been quiet 17 days because the PTR cycle ended when 12.1 shipped on 08-11. (2) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block (never by tag adjacency — items are <title> THEN <link>): 40 items, newest 2026-08-16 19:10 CDT. (3) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute), because it leads RSS within a run: 20 posts, top id 382391 — nothing beyond RSS. (4) Blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, newest 2026-08-14 20:02, unchanged since last night. The only class-touching blues remain Linxy's "Class Tuning Incoming - August 18" (topic 2336820), which IS the feed's 2026-08-15 entry, and the Aug-14 Kaivax hotfixes. Kaivax's 08-12 "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans" and Wowhead's 08-12 "Class Tuning Roadmap" remain a CALENDAR (Aug 18 / Aug 25 / Sep 1 / Sep 22) with no per-spec numbers, so they are still correctly not in the feed. Writeup coverage recomputed rather than read: 1 spec at ptr:null (Demonology Warlock, a deliberate null — the source reported no changes), 0 specs without a raid-scoped expert read, 0 without an M+ one.

Discovery complete, distillation impossible — 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added, and no `latest` field advanced. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0, because the queue was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran (the 08-16 local run drained all 12). No transcript was fetched from YouTube or any API by this agent. 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff, 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries diffed against a 1045-id seen-set built from the four STRUCTURED lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never a regex over log prose. 55 unseen, all in-cycle against the 2026-06-18 bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, not builds[0]). NINE QUEUED under the nightly's keyword filter and the fetch-broadly/queue-narrowly rule, all take-shaped: Shadarek d99gGdPLxFI + VooDooSaurus byBgZmZlzxI + Jedith QOmfIifvkgw (three independent Devourer-nerf reads), NeekapHere yUVywQqHtVs (Retribution), izen KktdoK1OZVY (the general-creator S2 M+ meta list -> metaNotes lane), LBNinja7 MId00Jg51mo, AutomaticJak mzjGn70Hf20 (a tier-list stream; his last one yielded 13 takes), Bicepspump Y9Jlp2E04No (media:description promises meta predictions for both DK specs) and Whispyr b3kZyBt660U. ONE retired to seen[] as durable: Kalamazi syMKQGVlERo, a BBQ cooking stream, not WoW at all. The other 45 stay UNSEEN because none is a durable judgment, and the split is counted rather than estimated: 19 guides/routes/trinket lists, 13 stream or Short shells, 10 PvP-framed uploads (Supatease x9 + one Dalaran duels video), Tactyks ZS1GMWVLegs (M+, and he writes the Method M+ list, so it is firewalled by construction), Harrek QevyPqgpoEs (raw Dummy Dome pull footage, no comparative read), and Dratnos 8b-nyzqIaQ8 whose own chapter list is entirely RWF logistics with no spec-strength segment. media:description again settled most of the triage at zero transcript cost. Nothing installed or upgraded.
